title: Hidden While Invis
description: This is a simple plugin that obfuscates name in chat and in tablist when using an invis pot.
body:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/oZ4EPywoiSY" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>This plugin obfuscates player names when they use an invis pot both in chat and in tablist.
Disclaimer..... This wont work on player prefixes on tablist, there may be a way around this but I just didnt do it. ALSO when players leave the effect will stop even if they are invis when they log back on ~~~~
